subject.title: [Feature]: Merge the composer voice level meter into the stop-voice control and disambiguate the two stop buttons

question: Should Control UI Talk adopt the proposed integrated meter/stop-voice pill and distinct run-abort danger button for the composer?
rationale: The source-level problem is clear, but this is a maintainer-labeled user-facing UX feature whose final visual and interaction contract should be sponsored before automation changes the composer.

options.title: Sponsor integrated stop-voice pill
options.body: Implement the proposed meter-in-button design with focused accessibility, reduced-motion, and layout proof.

options.title: Use a lighter disambiguation pass
options.body: Keep the separate meter but change the stop controls enough to avoid adjacent identical danger buttons.

options.title: Keep current composer controls
options.body: Leave the separate activity pill and two stop buttons until a broader Talk composer refresh is planned.

recommendation.title: Sponsor integrated stop-voice pill
recommendation.body: Implement the proposed meter-in-button design with focused accessibility, reduced-motion, and layout proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current report and recent Talk meter/button history, making him the best available routing owner for this UX direction.
